caveats: Google Search and Google Maps returned an 'unusual traffic' block from this network, so no Google Business Profile data (rating, review count, claimed status, hours, photos) could be captured for any business. Ratings are recorded as unknown rather than estimated.

Yellow Pages, Superpages and BBB returned HTTP 403 / Cloudflare blocks to both fetch_content and the browser, so those pages could not be read directly; their content appears only as search-result summaries and is treated as weak evidence.

Six of ten records are 'not found' because no primary source confirms them. That reflects stale source directories (ibegin, loc8nearme, allpages) as much as business failure - a phone call would settle each one.
Only four businesses could be confirmed operating, and only Arthur's Self Storage has a website, which limits how comparable the website and agent-readiness detail is across the batch.
Judgments about customer mix, missed-call risk and automation value for phone-only shops are inferences from carrier/shop size and the absence of web intake; none is stated by the businesses.
data_gaps: Google Business Profile ratings, review counts, claimed status and hours: unavailable (bot check on google.com).
